scripts.hosting:create: wrangler pages project create language-cafe-instagram-assets --production-branch main
scripts.service-db: node -e "const store=require('./service/data-store.cjs'); console.log({ databasePath: store.databasePath, workspaces: store.listWorkspaces() });"
scripts.review-animated-card-reel: node review-reel.cjs --file reels/card-reel-v3/meaning-switch-01-animated-card-reel.mp4 --report reels/card-reel-v3/reel-review-report.json --label "Animated card Reel prototype: meaning-switch-01"
scripts.review-motion-card-reel: node review-reel.cjs --file reels/motion-card-reel-v4/meaning-switch-01-motion-card-reel.mp4 --report reels/motion-card-reel-v4/reel-review-report.json --max-duration 35 --label "Frame-rendered motion card Reel: meaning-switch-01"
scripts.make-reel-bgm: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File make-original-bgm.ps1 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File mix-reel-bgm.ps1
scripts.review-reel-bgm: node review-reel.cjs --file reels/motion-card-reel-v4/meaning-switch-01-motion-card-reel-bgm.mp4 --report reels/motion-card-reel-v4/reel-bgm-review-report.json --max-duration 35 --label "Motion Reel with original calm BGM: meaning-switch-01"
scripts.test:cloud: node --test cloud/*.test.cjs publish-safety.test.cjs public-image-hosting.test.cjs character-identity-lock.test.cjs carousel-pipeline-media-request.test.cjs content-queue/threads/prepare-threads-draft.test.cjs content-queue/threads/publish-threads.test.cjs
